meta.title: The Tax on Your Pay Stub Isn't Your Real Tax Bill
meta.hook: The tax taken from your paycheck isn't your real tax bill. It's a guess.
meta.description: Employers withhold estimated tax from every paycheck using IRS formulas based on your W-4 form, but that's only an estimate of what you'll owe for the year. The true amount is reconciled the following spring when you file — a big refund usually means you overpaid an interest-free amount to the government all year. Educational content only, not personalized tax advice.

scenes.narration: The tax taken from your paycheck isn't your real tax bill. It's a guess.

scenes.narration: Employers withhold money from every paycheck using IRS formulas based on what you put on a W-4 form.

visual.visual_intent: A tax form on a desk with a pen, neutral light, close focus

scenes.narration: That withholding is an estimate of what you'll owe for the year, not the final, exact number.

visual.visual_intent: A calculator display with numbers, close focus, neutral light

scenes.narration: If your employer withheld too much, you get the difference back as a refund the next spring.

visual.visual_intent: An envelope with a check being pulled out, close focus, warm light
visual.decision_reason: explains the over-withholding/refund case, IRS mechanics

scenes.narration: If they withheld too little, you owe the IRS the difference when you file.

visual.visual_intent: A calendar page marked with a tax deadline, close focus, neutral light
visual.decision_reason: explains the under-withholding/owe case, IRS mechanics

scenes.narration: A big refund can feel like a bonus. It usually just means you overpaid an interest-free loan to the government all year.

visual.visual_intent: A piggy bank sitting still on a table, neutral light, symbolic stillness
visual.decision_reason: reframes the refund as an interest-free overpayment, common IRS-explainer framing

scenes.narration: The number on your pay stub was never final. It was always just a placeholder.

visual.visual_intent: A folded pay stub being placed into a pocket, close focus, warm light
